name: blueprint
title: Blueprint
description: A product wipes left to right into a technical drawing with a blueprint grid, white linework, dimension lines and a red callout. A built-in red device stands in for the product; labels and colors are variables.
useWhen: A hardware or product launch should show the object as an engineering drawing: measured, labelled and precise.
One feature of the product deserves a callout, like a sensor, a port or a button.
The scene should switch from a glossy product shot to a technical one in a single readable move.
avoidWhen: The product should come apart into labelled layers instead of being measured: use exploded-view.
The reveal should show what is inside the device rather than its outline: use x-ray-scan.
The subject is a word whose outlines should draw themselves: use outline-trace.
author: Remocn
